name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 6 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 24 hours starting 2025-10-31, at wavelengths from 0.87 to 3.57 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
